title: Slow sand filter operation and limits log
summary: Records operation of slow sand filtration while clearly stating what it cannot solve.
content: Slow sand filter operation and limits log is a practical offline routine for water filter limits. Use only for sources not suspected of chemicals, fuel, heavy metals, sewage surge, or industrial contamination. Label source, date, flow rate, turbidity, smell, maintenance, and post-treatment method. Keep dirty inlet tools separate from clean outlet containers. Do not call filtered water safe until suitable disinfection or official guidance is satisfied. Stop use if flow changes suddenly, cracks appear, odor appears, or illness is linked to the water.
steps: Keep dirty inlet tools separate from clean outlet containers.
